text:
The front desk staff was terrible...bad service, rude language, narrow-minded. Clinics are popping up like mushrooms, and encountering staff like this...I'd rather not go there. I have money to pay, I can go anywhere else. I pay in cash.
The thing is, I'm a stay-at-home mom, the dad works abroad. I was free so I went in to consult about braces and brought my child with me. As soon as I opened the door, she immediately started scolding me for bringing a child without someone to watch him. I stayed calm and told her my child to wait. She kept rambling on, saying, "Don't bring him next time. Look, he seems so mischievous. There's no one to watch him." She spoke abruptly, staring at me from afar, leaning against the counter (my child was sitting quietly). I was stunned. My child was sitting still. I raise my child myself, we go everywhere together, I don't have any relatives. My child knows what I'm doing, he can wait. I go to hospitals, government offices, banks, temples... I understand they're afraid of causing a commotion, but I didn't leave my child there or cause any trouble. (Also, we went for a consultation, and when we schedule the treatment, we'll schedule it for a day when my child is at school.) But if she wanted to say something, there are a million words she could have used. She could have found better ways to speak, instead of speaking like she had some kind of complex. She keeps saying the same thing over and over. I have money; I can pay for it, I'm not asking for it to be done for free.
author_name: เปลวฟ้า จิรัตน์ตรานนท์

text:
I've been getting braces here for 3 years, and my teeth still haven't aligned. It's like the doctor is stalling. Sometimes, even after treatment, I feel like my teeth aren't being pulled properly, or my ligaments are thinning.
Just do the math: 30 months x 1,500 baht per month = 45,000 baht. And that doesn't even include scaling! That's almost half a hundred thousand baht. This clinic is terrible.

Other places only charge 36,000 baht, and the rest is free if there's still no improvement.
Or maybe other places have a promotion for 30,000 baht?
I recommend going to a different clinic.
